lines: Fire then: Supreme-Lord satisfied by sesame-ghee;
before him another animal for vapa-hom;
deity-wheel satisfied by its fat; mandala again
the disciple standing front let him make.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato 'gnau parameśvaraṃ tilājyādibhiḥ saṃtarpya tadagre 'nyaṃ paśuṃ vapāhomārthaṃ kuryāt devatācakraṃ tadvapayā tarpayet punar maṇḍalaṃ pūjayet tataḥ parameśvaraṃ vijñapya sarvābhinnasamastaṣaḍadhvaparipūrṇam ātmānaṃ bhāvayitvā śiṣyaṃ puro 'vasthitaṃ kuryāt

reads_against.argmap: What follows the paśu-offering? → The vapa-homārtha sequence: saṃtaraṇa → paśu-vapa → devatā-cakra-tarpaṇa → maṇḍala → parameśvara-vijñāpana → self-contemplation → disciple placed.
c1_essence: Sesame-ghee, vapa-hom, fat-satisfied deity-wheel, disciple placed before the all-path-complete self.
